Container.Name: AutoCompress
Container.Overview: Scans one or more folders on a schedule and compresses every sub-folder into its own RAR archive (adjustable compression level, recovery record, optional password and split volumes), tests the archive, adds a CRC32 to the file name or writes an SFV file, then deletes the original folder or moves it to a trash folder. Web UI with live status, settings, history, statistics and themes. Uses the RARLAB rar program in trial mode unless you add your own licence key. Created entirely by AI (Claude). It has been tested, but not in every situation - it can delete your original folders, so try a dry run first, keep backups of data you cannot replace, and do your own due diligence before exposing it to the internet.
Container.Changes:
Build 8, published 2026-11-04.
### 2026-11-04 - Fix: files dated in the future (for example from a timezone mix-up on the computer that wrote them) no longer keep a folder waiting for hours. Their date is ignored and the time they arrived on the server is used. The Waiting card and the log now name the newest changed file, and warn about future-dated items. - New **Waiting** card on the Status page: folders skipped because they changed too recently are listed with their size and a countdown to when they are old enough, soonest first. It stays until the next scan starts. - The Status page now shows what happens to the original folders (Recycle Bin, delete, move or keep) and where: the Recycle Bin folder on your server and how many items it holds. The log names the Recycle Bin folder at the start of a run and for every folder moved there, and Stats has a Recycle Bin tile. - The folder locations box in Settings is now live: it follows the folders you type or pick (sources, output, move folder, Recycle Bin) and shows where each one is on your server, instead of only checking the four template paths. - The original folder now goes to the share's **`.Recycle.Bin`** by default (the place the Unraid Recycle Bin plugin uses for files deleted over SMB). Delete, move and keep are still available; existing settings are unchanged. If the share's root is not mapped into the container, Settings says so and a fresh install keeps the folders instead. - New optional path **All shares** (`/mnt/user`, under advanced settings in the template): with it mapped, the folder pickers and **Compress folder…** can reach any share, not only the mapped folders. - New **Compress folder…** button: pick any folder and compress it now as a one-off job, either as a single archive or as one archive per sub-folder. It ignores the scanned folders and the schedule, uses your compression settings, and lets you choose for that run only what happens to the folder afterwards and where the archive goes.
### 2026-11-03 - First release: every sub-folder of the folders you choose is compressed into its own RAR archive on a schedule or on demand. - Settings for the compression level, solid archives, dictionary size, recovery record, RAR threads, split volumes, password (with optional file name encryption) and files to leave out. - Each archive is tested and compared with the folder before anything is removed; a folder that changed while it was being compressed is never touched. - CRC32 in the file name (`Show [14337E9B].rar`) or in an SFV file, for new and for existing archives; a Check CRCs button verifies them later. - Original folders can be deleted, moved to a trash folder or kept; archives can go next to the folders or to a separate output folder. - Web UI with live status, settings, history, statistics, 11 themes, optional login and a build number.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, history, statistics and logs. Keep the Container Path /data.

Config.Name: Folders to compress
Config.Description: Every sub-folder of this folder is compressed into its own .rar archive (read/write). Choose the share that holds the folders, e.g. /mnt/user/to-compress. Keep the Container Path /source. More folders: use Add another Path and add them as sources in the web UI.

Config.Name: Archive output (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. /mnt/user/archives. If set, the .rar files are written here instead of next to the folders. Must not be inside the folder to compress. Keep the Container Path /output.

Config.Name: Trash folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. /mnt/user/trash. If set, compressed folders are moved here instead of deleted. Must not be inside the folder to compress (or a parent of it). Keep the Container Path /trash.

Config.Name: All shares (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, for the Compress folder button. Enter /mnt/user to let the web UI browse and compress any share, not just the folder above. Gives the container read/write access to all your shares, so leave it empty unless you need it. Keep the Container Path /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the times shown in logs.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Login name for the web UI (only used when a password is set). Default admin.

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the web UI. Blank = no login.
